subregion.name: The Central Workings
subregion.summary: A bustling hub of interconnected chambers and timbered galleries.

subregion.name: The Deep Sump
subregion.summary: Flooded corridors and narrow drainage passages plunging into the southernmost dark.

subregion.name: The Eastern Drift
subregion.summary: A maze of shallow prospect tunnels and abandoned side passages.

subregion.name: The North Approach
subregion.summary: Winding upper paths and exposed ledges leading down from the high ridges.

subregion.name: The Sunken Quarry
subregion.summary: Vast stone-cut halls and tailing chutes in the southwestern depths.

subregion.name: The Timbered Hollow
subregion.summary: A shored-up junction where old mining roads converge.

subregion.name: The Western Flumes
subregion.summary: Steep excavation shafts and sluice cuts carved into the western cliffs.
